entries.title: The next-meeting card fits a phone
entries.summary: The rotation row may wrap; only the four-name chain stays whole. Hanging indents keep wrapped lines under their titles. Measured at 320, 375, 768, and 1200.

entries.title: September’s stories on the card
entries.summary: Two title lines, the second hanging so it aligns under the first in the mono face. The block stops saying TBD.

entries.title: The archive becomes a wall of titles
entries.summary: Dense titles as the main material; notes and tags collapse behind a click per row, with a “+ all notes” toggle. The ledger on the card gets its newest row.

entries.title: The library form is the logo
entries.summary: A date-due card, after a real one JC supplied. The full ASCII card sits in the header; the favicon is the card in five strokes.
entries.note: “SSDG” alone doesn’t carry the mark at small sizes; the full name on ruled lines does.

options.title: Salmon card stock
options.blurb: Tried on the linslow tile. Rejected: not the card.

options.title: Cream card, thin blue rules, typewriter ink
options.blurb: The identity in every site’s footer.

options.title: The full ASCII card in the header
options.blurb: Call number, AUTHOR Various, TITLE Two short stories, monthly. The ledger rows are real sessions.

entries.title: Every story gets a reader-facing description
entries.summary: All sessions rewritten for a reader, not for the group. All Play joins the rotation as its own station.

entries.title: The index table is generated from the archive
entries.summary: The sync script rewrites the story table from the vault record. Author cells no longer truncate at a comma; collections are italicized.

entries.title: The card points at the next picker
entries.summary: August is an all-play; the arrow moves to JC for September.

entries.title: Personal news leaves the public notes
entries.summary: Third-party news and a grief line come out of the public record.

entries.title: Elsewhere joins the footer
entries.summary: Links to the other four properties, under the bewilderment prayer.
